second_rite.title: The Second Rite
second_rite.body: A summoner's bond is not ownership. The Second Rite names the promise renewed between the caller and the called: strength is shared, memory is kept, and no sacrifice is forgotten.

summoner_mana.title: Summoner Mana
summoner_mana.body: Every manifested creature draws from the Summoner's shared mana. The bond is strongest in battle, but even an expedition taxes it with every step beyond safe ground.

old_gate.title: The Old Gate
old_gate.body: Weathered marks around the gate do not match the masonry. Someone rebuilt the arch long after the road beneath it was abandoned.
